# VU Mega Index — Bot-Ready Master File

Standardized index of **28328 unique files** across **411 course codes** (plus GENERAL). Every file has the same field design: `COURSE | NAME | FORMAT | TYPE | TAGS | LINK`. Built for programmatic parsing by the WhatsApp bot.

```
FIELD FORMAT (identical for every record):
COURSE=<code> NAME=<original file name> FORMAT=<PDF|DOC|PPT|IMAGE|XLS|TXT|ARCHIVE|OTHER> TYPE=<MIDTERM|FINALTERM|QUIZ|ASSIGNMENT|HANDOUT|MCQFILE|OTHER> TAGS=<MCQ|OBJECTIVE|SUBJECTIVE|SOLVED|PAST-PAPER|... or NONE> LINK=<direct google drive url>
```
